title: Setup → Positions list shows no holder count and no bound permission sets, and only the name cell opens the row — so the list cannot answer "who is a sales manager?" (hotcrm#2194 T2-U05, the platform half)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 岗位列表看不到持有人数和绑定的权限集，只有名称单元格能点开，回答不了「谁是销售经理」。
- **要做：** 列表显示持有人数和绑定的权限集，整行可点。HotCRM 补岗位描述的那一半另立卡，等本卡。
- **完成标准：** 列表一眼看出每个岗位有几个人、授予哪些权限集。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T2-U05 (the platform half)**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** Setup → Positions, the system administrator.
- **Now:** the list shows no holders and no bound sets; only the name cell is clickable. The list cannot answer "who is a sales manager?".
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/REPORT.md), U-05; [`sweep-12-positions.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/sweep-12-positions.png). Re-measured unchanged on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 by the round 2 pass ([round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), the section's opening paragraph).

## Landing

- The tester's reading: the console metadata list for the `position` type (objectui renders it), fed by the server's position catalog and `sys_user_position`.
- Pairs with #24757 (open, on hold): a position's same-named permission set is in force but invisible. A list column showing the bound sets must show what is in force, so the claim reads #24757's state first.
- Since objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2229 every HotCRM position declares its `permissionSets`, which is what the column would show.
- The HotCRM half (position descriptions) is filed on objectstack-ai/hotcrm `pm:blocked` on this card.

## Done when

- Setup → Positions shows, per row, the holder count and the permission sets the position grants, and the whole row opens the position.
- The counts and sets match what the server enforces (a pin on the list's data, and #24757's reading quoted).

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectstack issue (108) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (544, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `position`. 5 open hits: #24757 (pairs, above), #25251 (a security gate on assignment rows), #25249, #12224 and #9559 (other subjects); none is this list. **New** for the list columns.
